column1: # price-table.tsv — consumer config for the --emit stage-economics arm (drift-kit/SPEC.md §The stage-economics meter).
# Copy this beside your gates dir (default scripts/price-table.tsv, DRIFT_KIT_PRICE_TABLE) and
# replace the placeholder rows with YOUR model roster. The per-token prices are public facts, but
# the roster of models you run is yours — a kit literal enumerating it would publish it (the
# provenance seam / graph-vocab pattern), so this template ships the schema and placeholders only.
# priced-as-of: 2000-01-01 — replace with the date you last transcribed these numbers.
# prices-valid-through: 2000-01-01 — optional; the date the table is vouched for through:
# a cliff whose next rate is unpublished, or a re-check horizon. Drop this line if neither
# applies. A scheduled change whose next rate is published is a row dated for the change
# instead. The prose below cites this header rather than restating its date. Both headers
# are read by kpi-price-table-age (drift-kit/SPEC.md §Bundled KPIs): age alone cannot see
# a cliff, since a freshly retyped table reads freshest on the morning its prices stop
# being true.
# An optional price-page-hash: header carries the hash --price-coverage prints when
# DRIFT_KIT_PRICE_PAGE_CMD is set, transcribed with priced-as-of:.
# Tab-separated. One row per model id and effective date (the id as it appears in the
# transcript's message.model; effective_from optional, an ISO day, empty for an open start).
# Columns are USD per single token (a $/MTok price ÷ 1,000,000). A model with no row in force
# degrades its cost cell to n/a — token counts still report; pricing is advisory, never required.
